collection.description: A villager repairs a fine net while butterflies pass overhead.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1) repairs a fine net while butterflies pass overhead. The butterfly is gently released after everyone has looked.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1) repairs a fine net while butterflies pass overhead. (Name1) is amazed by a pattern almost invisible from afar.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1) repairs a fine net while butterflies pass overhead. A sudden flutter makes the youngest observer laugh.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1) repairs a fine net while butterflies pass overhead. Someone sketches the colors before forgetting them.
